en: A hand‑colored historic postcard showing a tree‑lined street with an elegant two‑story villa named Villa Bechler. The house has light walls, green shutters, ornate wrought‑iron balcony and veranda, and a small front garden behind an iron fence. Several people in early 20th‑century clothing walk on the sidewalk. In the background a church spire rises above the trees. Printed captions and publisher information appear along the bottom border.
